description: This source file defines utility functions for cryptographic operations related to organization ID generation and decryption using AES-128-ECB mode. It includes functions to generate a consistent organization ID based on email and a tenant salt, and an optional decryption function for debugging purposes.

methods.name: hexToWordArray
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a CryptoJS WordArray.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId
methods.description: Generates a unique organization ID by encrypting a normalized email with a tenant-specific AES key and encoding the ciphertext.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId
methods.description: Decrypts an organization ID that was encrypted with generateOrganizationId, mainly for debugging purposes.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid
methods.description: Checks if the tenant salt value is valid (non-empty).
